country.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/1] This is consistent with Winefield et al. (1990), who looked at school leavers in an Australian population and found no differences for psychological well-being between the dropouts and stayers. Consistent with further findings of the study by Winefield et al. (1990), no difference was found for self-esteem in the current study of school leavers in regard to these two types of participants.
